xna-type.name: Plane
xna-type.remarks: The Plane structure represents a plane using a 3D vector normal and a distance value, as the following figure shows.

constructor.summary: Creates a new instance of Plane.

parameters.parameter: Vector4 with X, Y, and Z components defining the normal of the Plane . The W component defines the distance of the Plane along the normal from the origin.
